notes.title: BUMS 0.3 -> 0.31v / Big update!
notes.content:
List of main updates:
[olist]
 The game has become more logical, that is, at least cartridges are now not so difficult to find and without unnecessary actions you can understand where to look for them.
 Added training cartridge.
 Many objects on the map are now interactive.
In secret, when interacting with objects on the main map, you can find a very interesting bug that will allow you to fly “surf” on it directly through the air (perhaps soon it will be part of the game mechanics)
 The main map's appearance has been updated.
 All the necessary tips have been added to help a beginner and to find all existing cartridges at the moment. (5)
 Minor bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]
For a fairly large update, you can thank our esteemed guest who generously shared his advice in his channel:
PARAFRAGOFF
